title: Nutty Crispy Norwegian Poppy Seeds Flatbread
description: A light, crispy and nutty Norwegian-inspired flatbread featuring ground poppy seeds, perfect for breakfast or lunch. This recipe is free from onions and garlic.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine warm water, yeast and a pinch of sugar. Let it sit for 5 minutes until yeast is activated.
Add rapeseed oil, salt, whole wheat flour, ground poppy seeds, and soffritto to the bowl. Mix until dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch (6 mm) and cut it into desired shapes.
Place the dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 15-18 minutes or until golden brown.
Bake for an additional 5 minutes to crisp the flatbread further.
Remove from the oven and brush with lemon juice.
Store leftovers in an airtight container.
